findings.what: Stale comment in _phase_analyze still says 'NOT a demotion' and 'must not be flagged as damaged', contradicting the round-2 demotion now applied in _winning_page_output (WARNING) and _phase_assemble (AUDIT_FAILED).
findings.why: The comment block was written in round 1 when the change was surfacing-only. Round 2 added a real demotion, so the comment now misdescribes the behaviour and will mislead the next reader into thinking the page is not demoted.

findings.what: _row_union_bbox unions raw row rects without the word-expansion _numeric_row_bbox performs, so a native numeric token whose centre sits a point or two outside its row bbox is excluded from the fallback destruction scope.
findings.why: _numeric_row_bbox's own docstring warns that unioning row bboxes alone 'would then silently exclude that word'. The fallback scope inherits that gap. It is under-detection (a missed destroyed token), not a false positive, and only in the already-corrupted None path, so it is strictly better than round 1's skip and not blocking.

what_i_tried_to_break: I traced the None path end-to-end: _numeric_row_bbox -> None on a corrupted grid (cells like '0.6x' fail _cell_has_numeric_token while _looks_tabular still admits embedded digits), then _row_union_bbox -> union of row rects, then _destroyed_numeric_tokens re-locates each native token ('0.67' centre in row 1) and finds '0.67' not in raw cell '0.6x' -> destroyed. Detection is restored. For the false-positive direction I confirmed _row_union_bbox stops at the last row, so the overrun numeral '106' at y=850 (rows end y=840) is outside scope and the good grid is kept. I read _winning_page_output and confirmed the demotion only flips status/audit_passed on the returned synthetic PageOutput while text stays _native_text_with_appends(p) (unchanged), and that _winning_page_output never reads or mutates best_output, so it is not the #252 winner-selection flip. I checked every new test against base 83924e9 signatures: reconstruct_table_regions is called without the rejections= kwarg, _row_union_bbox/is_numeric_token/strip_presentation are never imported, and the new PageState field is read via getattr(..., False). I did NOT run the tests (the code-owner worktree is at the head, not base, and I avoided the editable-install trap); non-vacuity is confirmed by reading the test file against the base signatures.
